messages:
nina: Heads up, sample-app CI started failing after a typegen regen on main. Failures are auth/retry tests + publish gate due to regendiff.
omar: Which tests and what regendiff output?
nina: auth-retry.unit.ts flakes with 502s. regen-bot shows checksum drift and a rename in generated helpers.
regen-bot: regendiff: 1 file changed, checksum old: d4a8f0 new: e5b9c1. Notable: helper renamed _doRequestRetry -> _doRequestBackoff; key ordering in GeneratedOptions changed.
chloe: The ordering should be harmless for consumers, but our publish gating compares generated source text which flags it. The helper rename is risky if tests import internals.
omar: Quick fixes: pin typegen version in sample-app CI, update tests to avoid private imports, and add a grep check to detect private-symbol usage.
nina: I've opened PR 617 to pin the generator and patch tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/617.
chloe: Longer term: add deterministic sorting to codegen output and improve regendiff heuristics to ignore ordering-only diffs. Also consider stable internal helper naming.
omar: Also update CHANGELOG gating policy: identify purely cosmetic generated changes so changelog rules don't block patches.
ci-bot: CI snippet: 
RUN auth-retry.unit.ts
 should retry on 5xx and succeed
Error: 502 Bad Gateway
    at fetch_mock.ts:48

nina: Plan: merge the pin/tests PR if CI green, then file an eng-tooling ticket to harden typegen and regendiff rules. Closing after PR merges.
